description: Reviewed per-behavior C# runtime mutation kernels for the four mutation-required release behaviors. Mutation ownership is intentionally independent from BehaviorDoc fact-extractor consumedInputs: compiled observation dependencies include DTOs, declarative catalogs and broad hosting files that are not executable mutation targets. Every selected kernel is covered by the binding-owned test class for its behavior, and exact disjoint source ownership keeps every Stryker mutant attributable to one behavior.
